english.title: Driver of London hackney carriage fail to provide sufficient evidence of hire at time of refusal to hire
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY HACKNEY CARRIAGE..), found standing in a street or place at **(..SPECIFY STREET OR PLACE..), and the subject of a complaint under section 35 of the London Hackney Carriage 1831, failed to produce sufficient evidence of having been and of being actually hired at the time of a refusal to go with **(..SPECIFY POTENTIAL HIRER..), a person desirous of hiring such hackney carriage
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35 of the London Hackney Carriage Act 1831.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the driver of a hackney carriage found in a street or place
failed, upon the hearing of a complaint against you against a refusal to go with a person desirous of hiring the carriage
to produce sufficient evidence of having been and being hired at the time of the refusal
